title: Recipe Generator From Ingredients: Turn What You Have Into Dinner
description: Enter ingredients you already have, choose your time and meal type, and get practical dinner ideas with Delixio. Free to try, no subscription.
h1: Recipe generator from ingredients: turn what you have into dinner

hero.alt: Delixio Cook screen with ingredients added before generating recipe ideas.

intro: Got ingredients but no dinner plan? Delixio is a recipe generator that starts with what you already have. Add the food you want to use, choose your cooking time, servings, and meal type, then get practical recipe ideas for tonight.

Want to use only what is already at home? Choose Strict. Happy to pick up one or two extras? Choose Flexible. You can explore recipe ideas for free, then unlock a full recipe when you are ready to cook.

sections.heading: A simple method for ingredient-first cooking
paragraphs: Most “what should I cook?” decisions fail because people start with a recipe that needs a shopping trip. Flip the process:
steps: Write down the ingredients you want to use first (especially anything that should be eaten soon).
Add pantry staples you always have, oil, salt, garlic, onions, rice, pasta, eggs, spices.
Choose a format that matches your time and energy: skillet, pasta, soup, salad, bowl, or oven dish.
Decide whether you will cook only with what you have, or allow one or two missing items.
Season boldly. Leftover vegetables and proteins often need acid, salt, spice, or herbs to taste finished.

sections.heading: Examples you can try tonight
paragraphs: Here are realistic combinations and the meals they often become:

examples.title: Chicken + broccoli + rice
examples.text: Stir-fry or rice bowl with garlic, soy or lemon, and a little chili if you like heat.

examples.title: Eggs + spinach + cheese + tortillas
examples.text: Quick scramble wraps or a simple skillet breakfast-for-dinner.

examples.title: Canned tomatoes + pasta + garlic + herbs
examples.text: Pantry pasta with optional leftover vegetables stirred through at the end.

examples.title: Chickpeas + cucumber + yogurt + lemon
examples.text: Cold salad bowl or warm skillet chickpeas with a yogurt dressing.

sections.heading: Strict, Flexible, and Creative thinking
paragraphs: Strict means cook with only your ingredients. Flexible allows about 1–2 missing items. Creative explores more inventive ideas with smart extras when you need them.
In Delixio these are cooking modes, so you can choose the trade-off before you generate ideas. Learn more in the [[/faq/#cooking-modes|cooking modes FAQ]].

delixio.heading: How Delixio helps
paragraphs: Delixio is an AI recipe app for iPhone and Android. You type ingredients you already have, choose preferences (cooking time bands, servings, meal type), pick Strict, Flexible, or Creative mode, and generate personalized meal ideas, ideas are free.

When you unlock a full recipe, it costs 1 credit. You get 1 free full recipe every day, and optional packs of 6, 28, or 90 credits. No subscription. From there you can review missing ingredients, save recipes to lists, build a grocery list, and plan meals.

related.label: What can I cook with these ingredients?

faq.q: What is a recipe generator from ingredients?
faq.a: It is a tool or method that starts from foods you already have and suggests meals that use them, instead of starting from a recipe that forces a shopping list.

faq.q: Do I need every ingredient measured perfectly?
faq.a: No. For home cooking it is usually enough to list the main ingredients you want to use. Exact quantities can be adjusted when you cook.

faq.q: Can Delixio generate recipes from my ingredients?
faq.a: Yes. Enter the ingredients you want to use, choose preferences and a cooking mode, generate free recipe ideas, then unlock a full recipe with 1 credit when you want the complete version.
Yes. Recipe ideas are free to generate, and you get 1 free full recipe every day. New users also start with 2 credits. Extra packs (6, 28, or 90) are optional, no subscription.
